title: Simplicity and Interoperability
guidingQuestion: How do we connect the web without forcing people into yet another app?
summary: A simple, interoperable Meta-Layer reduces digital fragmentation so tools, communities, and identities work across the open web.
opportunity: One interoperable layer across the Web

hero.headline: The next layer should simplify, not multiply tabs.
hero.text: People already juggle too many logins, chats, and tools. Interoperability means capabilities compose across sites instead of forcing yet another destination.

problemStory.title: Why this matters
problemStory.scenario: A volunteer coordinates across five apps for one campaign: chat here, docs there, events somewhere else. Context is lost in the seams, and newcomers never catch up.

webLimitations.title: Why today's Web struggles
webLimitations.text: Each product optimizes for its own retention. Standards exist, but product incentives reward lock-in, so users pay the complexity tax.

futureVision.title: Imagine instead
futureVision.text: Presence, identity, community, and context travel as a coherent layer above pages and apps.
bullets: Simple defaults that still allow depth

audiences.label: Enterprises
audiences.why: Compose tools without endless custom glue.
